Here my personal list of warez tools to search, stream and download movies, series, musics and softwares. ## CLI * [rdcli](https://github.com/johackim/rdcli) - Download and unrestrict DDL files, torrents and magnets * [netclix](https://github.com/johackim/netclix) - Search movie streaming links. * [plowshare](https://github.com/mcrapet/plowshare) - Download on file-sharing websites like uptobox, uploaded.. * [pirate-get](https://github.com/vikstrous/pirate-get) - Search torrents on The Pirate Bay * [pirateflix](https://github.com/orinocoz/pirateflix) - Stream videos from The Pirate Bay * [megatools](https://github.com/megous/megatools) - Download on mega * [torrentflix](https://github.com/ItzBlitz98/torrentflix) - Search and stream videos on torrent websites. * [peerflix](https://github.com/mafintosh/peerflix) - Streaming torrent client * [torrench](https://github.com/kryptxy/torrench) - Torrent search tool * [aria2](https://github.com/aria2/aria2) - Bitorrent client ## GUI * [popcorntime](https://github.com/popcorn-official/popcorn-desktop) - Easily watch movies through torrent streaming * [Qbittorrent](https://github.com/qbittorrent/qBittorrent) - BitTorrent client with a search feature * [magnetissimo](https://github.com/sergiotapia/magnetissimo) - Web application that indexes all popular torrent sites, and saves it to the local database * [deezloader](https://frama.link/5U5_Nesy) - Deezer downloader * [Terrarium TV](http://terrarium-tv.com/) - PopcornTime like for android ## Torrent Websites * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * ## Direct Download Websites * * ## Streaming * * * ## Unblock Warez Websites *
